positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Ensured that Production issues were identified and fixed in a timely manner (72 hours limit).
•	Made fixes recommendations; reviewed/wrote the documentation for the developers.
•	Maintenance of existing applications; Coaching new staff; Managing Offshore resources (India)
•	Hands on leader of the group researching the causes of possible technical bugs. Documentation.  
•	Coordination and planning of tasks assigned to on-site, off-site resources. 
•	Daily progress meetings and reporting. Use of timeline internal tools.

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
•	Developed/Enhanced existing applications (IFA Software), design, development using 2E (COBOL, RPG):
Hours saved per annum:  Due Diligence (400), Repayments, References Cleanup = 2000 each   CCI (Java) = 1600
•	OS upgrades (Operating System, PTF). Installed WAS on I-series. AIX on a new partition.
•	Developed System utilities: Automated FTP. SQL/ILE conversion generator.
•	Developed full Java J2EE module (500 Hours) – multiple JSP/Servlets (MVC) – using RAD7. 
•	Major player in the Conversion from current IFA software (2E COBOL) to in-house Code using RAD7, ILE RPG, SQLRPGLE.  
•	Automated (RPG) several applications after a personnel contraction. Bump monitoring.
